jobs.name: UCF CDL
jobs.title: Techranger
jobs.description: Currently developing web software as a part of the Center for Distributed Learning, a team inside UCF which develops open-source educational software used by 100+ institutions and tens of thousands of students worldwide.
bullets: Contributed to major updates for our gamified learning platform, Materia, making sweeping responsive design changes in React, and upgrading developer tools to support a full Python rewrite.
Took over development of a new dashboard for user-generated content in Materia, focusing on interaction design, UI/UX implementation, and detailed meta-data searching.
Working with various faculty members and designers to fully rewrite multiple Materia activities in JavaScript, improving student accessibility and adding pedagogical value.
Deployed a major update to an LTI tool for quiz accessibility requests on AWS EC2 servers, writing new Docker configurations and upgrading it to support the newer, more secure LTI 1.3 standard.

jobs.name: Knight Hacks
jobs.title: Senior Hackathon Organizer, Developer
jobs.description: Knight Hacks is a UCF RSO for software development, with the goal of empowering students to improve their technical skills and gain real experience.
bullets: Authored attendance tracking systems and an accompanying management interface in React and Node.js, storing valuable metrics for 60 workshop/sponsor events and 6,400+ check-in instances throughout the weekend while implementing rapid hot-fixes.

Organized the Knight Hacks VIII hackathon with 90% positive ratings, as well as developing for our hacker management infrastructure, Blade, which achieved a peak of about 850 concurrent users during the event.

Created a permission management system for Blade, which syncs roles with our Discord community to allow for improved onboarding of new team members and heightened security for our hackathon operations.

jobs.name: DenTraceX
jobs.title: Lead Developer, Vice President
jobs.description: DenTraceX is a Florida non-profit organization dedicated to collecting dental records of missing persons, in order to cross-reference them with unidentified remains. My main role as Lead Developer is the implementation of the entire organization's tech stack, such as our database, security, and client-facing webpages.
bullets: Co-founded a non-profit organization dedicated to collecting dental records of missing persons, in order to cross-reference them with unidentified remains.
Authored our organization infrastructure entirely from scratch using React, ExpressJS, PostgreSQL, and an AWS S3 bucket for secure data storage.

Constructed a novel code-based representation for jaw/tooth records, allowing easy searching/filtering to identify real-world human remains, intended for use by medical examiners and independent investigators.
Working with a team of diverse disciplines to process and handle sensitive medical information and maintain legal compliance.

jobs.name: Publix Super Markets
jobs.title: Cashier
jobs.description: Working as a Cashier, I interacted with hundreds of customers a day, making sure that their needs are met and that they are truly happy to shop at Publix. As my first job, it's where I built much of my soft skills and self-accountability.
bullets: Processing customer transactions efficiently while providing great service.
Able to adapt easily to changes in working condition/customer inflow.
Working as a team to ensure the completion of all daily tasks while keeping store operations running smoothly.
